# Crunch Carbon

> Turn solar energy into verified carbon credits and cash in South Africa.

## What We Do

Crunch Carbon helps South African homeowners and businesses monetize their solar panels by converting clean energy generation into verified carbon credits. We handle all the complexity - registration, verification, and credit sales - so you can earn passive income from your existing solar investment.

## For Homeowners

Earn R600-R1,000+ annually from a typical 5kWp residential solar system.

- **Free to join** - No setup costs or hidden fees
- **Passive income** - We do all the work, you get paid
- **Verra VCS certified** - International carbon credit standard
- **Annual payouts** - Receive earnings after verification cycle

**Learn more**: https://crunchcarbon.com/home-owners
**Calculate earnings**: https://crunchcarbon.com/calculator

## For Solar Installers & Agents

Partner with us to offer carbon credit monetization to your clients.

- **Earn commissions** on every client referral
- **Add value** to your solar installations
- **White-label proposals** with your branding
- **Dashboard** to track all your referrals

**Become a partner**: https://crunchcarbon.com/agents

## How It Works

1. **Register your solar system** - Takes 5 minutes
2. **We verify your installation** - Using your inverter data
3. **Carbon credits are generated** - Based on actual energy produced
4. **Credits are sold** - On international carbon markets
5. **You get paid** - Annual payouts to your bank account

## Eligibility

- Solar PV system installed in South Africa
- System size: Any size (residential or commercial)
- Must have data access (inverter monitoring)
- System must be grid-tied or hybrid

## Trust & Verification

- **Verra VCS Standard** - Globally recognized carbon credit certification
- **CDSA Affiliated** - Carbon Data Standards Association member
- **Bank-level encryption** - Your data is secure
- **1,500+ systems** already registered
